quarterly_data.signal: ASML's Q3 2026 release and US GAAP statements (6-K): 113 new and 8 used lithography systems were sold in Q3 2026 (86 new and 5 used in Q2 2026); sales of lithography systems were 121 units in Q3 2026 versus 72 in Q3 2025, and 291 units in the first nine months of 2026 versus 225 (metrology and inspection systems excluded). Payroll employees were 44,681 FTEs and temporary employees 1,078 FTEs at the end of Q3 2026 (43,461 and 789 a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: 121 lithography systems sold in Q3 2026 (113 new, 8 used) vs 72 in Q3 2025; 291 in the first nine months vs 225

quarterly_data.signal: ASML's Q3 2026 US GAAP balance sheet (6-K): non-current contract liabilities were EUR 9,300.6 million at September 27, 2026, versus EUR 3,570.3 million at June 28, 2026 and EUR 3,366.3 million at December 31, 2025; total non-current liabilities rose to EUR 12,013.0 million from EUR 6,234.8 million at June 28, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: non-current contract liabilities EUR 9,300.6 million (Sep 27, 2026) vs EUR 3,570.3 million (Jun 28, 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: ASML's Q3 2026 results presentation (6-K) describes the ASML and TSMC initiative to pioneer the industry transition to 12-inch photomasks for High NA EUV as enabling a >40% productivity increase for a dual mask exposure.
quarterly_data.figure: >40% productivity increase for a dual mask exposure
